about_short_description.short_description: SFA Therapeutics is a developer of drugs to treat chronic inflammatory diseases.

product.name: SFA-002
product.description: An oral immunomodulator targeting multiple cellular pathways to treat autoimmune diseases, initially for mild-to-moderate chronic plaque psoriasis.

product.name: SFA-009
product.description: A therapeutic candidate developed as an adjunct treatment to standard therapies for pancreatic cancer.

product.name: SFA-003
product.description: A novel therapeutic candidate for bullous pemphigoid, a rare autoimmune blistering skin disease, currently in late preclinical development.

product.name: SFA-001
product.description: A therapeutic candidate targeting epigenetic pathways for the treatment of hepatocellular carcinoma (liver cancer).

product.name: SFA-001N
product.description: A therapeutic candidate for metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis (MASH) focusing on liver fibrosis and inflammation.

product.name: SFA-004/5
product.description: Therapeutic candidates in development for inflammatory eye disease (uveitis) and relapsed chronic myeloid leukemia/acute myeloid leukemia (CML/AML).
